title: 四十隻小羊
subject: a helper on a taitung dairy-goat farm in kidding season bottle-feeding forty kids at five in the morning, every one named after a colleague from his old office, and the bossy one named after his manager who keeps eating his straw hat
caption: Modern Nashville country pop sung in Mandarin, mid-2020s radio-country sound. A bright banjo rolling steady eighth notes; a twangy Telecaster with chicken-picking licks between vocal lines; a strummed steel-string acoustic; pedal steel swells under the chorus; a stomp-clap backbeat over a live kit and a warm round bass. Clean, wide, polished radio mix with the vocal dry and up front. Male baritone lead, easygoing and slightly gravelly, conversational with a grin, gang vocals joining on the last chorus. 112 BPM, G major. Sunny, teasing, early-morning farm work. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no Mandopop ballad strings, no Chinese folk instruments.
lyrics:
[Intro - banjo roll, Telecaster lick, stomp-clap]

[Verse 1]
早上五點的台東 天還沒全亮
四十個奶瓶 排在鐵架上
小羊一看到我 全部擠過來
好像早餐車 開進了羊欄

[Pre-Chorus]
我說排好 一隻一隻來
可是牠們 從來不排隊

[Chorus]
四十隻小羊 每隻都有名字
全是我以前 公司的同事
最吵的那隻 叫做小陳
最兇的那隻 我叫牠經理

[Verse 2]
經理今天 又咬走我的草帽
站在圍欄邊 嚼得很驕傲
我追了三圈 牠還回頭看我
跟開會的時候 一模一樣

[Chorus]
四十隻小羊 每隻都有名字
全是我以前 公司的同事
小陳在我腳邊 睡著了
經理 帽子還我好不好

[Bridge - banjo and pedal steel alone, then stomp-clap returns]
以前我每天說 好的 收到
現在我每天說 慢慢喝 不要搶

[Chorus - gang vocals]
四十隻小羊 每隻都有名字
今天早上 又多生了兩隻
我想了一整個早上
就叫牠們 星期六 星期天

[Outro - Telecaster and banjo trade licks, one last stomp]
